sidecar_query_incident_list.error: tool dispatch failed for `query_incident_list`: decryption failed

verdict.reasoning: load_active_incidents runs `WHERE workspace = ?1 AND status != 'resolved'` and then decrypts the payload BLOB of EACH ROW THE FILTER RETURNED. A decryption error is therefore only reachable when the filter matched at least one row. Before the fix the same query against the same data dir with 2 active incidents returned total: 0 with NO error — the filter matched nothing. After the fix it reaches decryption. The change in failure mode is the proof that the key now aligns.
verdict.why_total_N_is_unobtainable_here: A second, pre-existing defect (see blocked_by) makes ANY cross-process read of an encrypted corpus payload fail on this host, for every workspace key. No end-to-end count is achievable until it is fixed — this is not a property of the workspace key.
